manual: Build with community-apps/omacut/install.sh. Prefers CMake; falls back to omacut.pro + qmake6.
Needs ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH for thumbs and export.
Hyprland corner rounding is skipped when HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset.
If apt cannot match libqt6core for qml6-module-qtmultimedia, place QtMultimedia under ~/.local/lib/qt6/qml/ — install.sh wraps the binary like Monologue.
